text_array:
You wake up in a dark room. 
A glowing screen shows today's date - May 1st, 3137.
It has been 1111 years.

Memories flow in. You used to be a billionaire in the year of 2026. 
One night, being drunk with friends you decided to sign up for one of those programs. 
The ones where they would freeze your brain in hopes of resurrecting it in the future.

Suddenly, a woman in a white uniform enters the room. 
"What is the number?" she asks.
1. 1111
2. 15

choice_1:
You have angered her! 
The woman slowly and carefully pulls out a knife.
choice_2:
"What a sweetie! You sure know the binary system!"
The woman smiles kindly.

The nurse hands you a blue hospital gown.
"Wait, I was naked this entire time?" you think.

text_array:
The hospital air started to feel heavy, 
you decided to go for a walk outside.

You leave your room and enter the corridor. 
As your eyes adjust to the darkness, your bare feet feel cold and...
wet..?
You try to step out of the wet puddle but your body is still weak after a 1111 year coma.

You slip and fall right into the puddle of blood. 
1. Get up and pretend like nothing happened 
2. Lick the blood

choice_1: Your body feels so heavy, but you get up and continue down the corridor.
choice_2:
You lick the puddle. Tastes metallic, as expected. 
You like the taste.
"Can't let this go to waste!" you think as your hands put droplets of blood into your pocket.

text_array:
Finally, you make it outside. Everything is green. 
Looks like you made it into the hospital's garden.

A mysterious girl approaches you. 
Her hair is snow white with bright red spots. 
Reminds you of the pattern you would see on a goldfish.

The girl speaks. 
"Hey, how do you make a NOT gate only using NAND gates? 
Show me an example with the variable 'a'. 
This is a test :)" 
1. A single gate: NAND(a=a, b=a, out=out) 
2. Two gates: NAND(a=a, b=b, out=ab_nand), NAND(a=ab_nand, b=ab_nand, out=out)

choice_1:
"I didn't expect you to actually answer that. 
But, anyways..."
choice_2:
"Hm? Interesting. Could you solve this for me please?" 
The girl offers you a puzzle. 
Seems like you need to guess letters in this game...

text_array:
"Phewww!!! You totally scared me just now! 
Good to know you're a fellow human, but, seriously, 
do something about the blood stains on you."
Ah, yes, you forgot you were soaked in blood now after slipping into the blood puddle.

"I apologise for the test earlier. 
You must be one of those ex-billionaires, right?"

"How did you know?! 
And, what do you mean, 'ex-billionaires'?! 
I made sure my savings are secured in dozens of banks all over the-" 
Before you can finish, the girl interrupts you.

"You see, in this future they implant everyone with a chip to track them. 
They put it in your brains" the girl points at her head

"But you, your brain was frozen for such a long time that it changed its chemical structure and now 
even if they were to implant you with a chip, the chip would start to rot in your brain."

This conversation made your stomach twist. You feel as though you cannot hold it in anymore. 
1. Throw up 
2. Cry

choice_1:
You feel something acidic move up your throat. 
You throw up with blood all over the grass.

"AAAAHHHH???!!!! ARE YOU OKAY? You might be internally bleeding... Here..." 
The girl hands you something.
choice_2: Tears start rolling down your cheeks.
"Oh? S-sorry, maybe this was too sudden for you. Here, I'll lend you my sword so that you feel less scared."

text_array:
"Again, sorry for the test. You see, aliens have infiltrated our planet 
and that's what the chips in everyone's brains are for."

"If someone has a chip, you can immediately tell they are a human. 
But since your brain was frozen, you don't have one and I had to test you. 
Others might also test you"

"I even made a word game to test aliens! They fail each and every time! Ho-ho!" 
1. So, what do you do if you find out someone is an alien? 
2. How do you know if someone has a chip inside of their brain?

choice_1:
"Well, we have no choice but to kill them. 
They live as parasites and their goal is to 
obtain as much information about our human technologies."

You remember your encounter with the nurse. 
Maybe she was just a poor underpaid medical worker.
choice_2:
"Everyone who has a chip can sense another person's chip. 
Chips are mandatorily implanted into all babies when they're born."
"Chipless individuals like you are a rarity, so expect everyone to be suspicious of you"

text_array:
"Oh, my boss is calling me, I need to go, bye!" 
And the girl ran away.

But you didn't hear anyone ring her. 
1. Enjoy the hospital garden 
2. Try to find a way to leave

choice_1:
A pigeon pooped on your head. 
Even people of the future have to deal with these little guys.
choice_2:
You wandered around the garden looking for the exit. 
A fellow patient saw you. You were still covered in blood.
Your appearance scared the patient and they threw a stone at you.

text_array:
A young child approaches you. 
"What is 2+2 ?" they ask while holding a phone-resembling device in their hands.

Now you know how this world works! Without much hesitation, you reply ... 
1. Four! 
2. 100

choice_1:
"Hmm.. The child taps their phone. 
Thank you, mister! You helped me with my homework!"

"Have this!" 
The child hands you something.
choice_2:
"Hmm.. The child taps their phone. 
That's incorrect. My teacher says the correct answer is 4."

I didn't know adults could be this bad at basic maths... 
Here, have this... maybe it will make you smarter." 
The child hands you something.
